scope: Actual gate/up weights with natural M256/M512 routing replay. Both modes include producer BF16-to-D8 packing and emit the complete selected-down D4 activation stream.

candidate.geometry: One local256 workgroup pairs 128 gate and 128 up columns over 32 routed rows, stores both BF16 boundaries in LDS, applies exact BF16 SiLU, and emits D4 blocks directly.
candidate.removed_work: Compact gate/up global materialization plus the standalone fused-SiLU D4 pack launch.
